sample_unit: questions (plus 20 patient scenarios), rated by 8 physician experts

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and completeness of chatbot answers to irAE guideline questions
links.effect: Accuracy 3.87 (ChatGPT) vs 3.5 (Bard), p<0.01; completeness 3.83 vs 3.46; scores of 1-2 rare for ChatGPT (6/800, 0.75%); patient scenarios accuracy 3.725, completeness 3.61.
links.quote: Overall, both engines scored highly for accuracy (mean scores for ChatGPT and Bard were 3.87 vs 3.5, p<0.01) and completeness (3.83 vs 3.46, p<0.01).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT and Bard on clinical immune-related adverse event scenarios without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
